prompt.label: Easy/Medium — Slow Employee Onboarding (NON-AI, workflow)
prompt.userMessage: As we continue hiring across multiple countries, onboarding new employees has become increasingly inconsistent and time-consuming. HR, IT, Legal, and department managers all operate with separate processes, so simple things like equipment access or compliance training often fall through the cracks. New hires sometimes wait more than a week before they can fully contribute, which is hurting productivity and first impressions. We want to create a smoother onboarding experience that feels coordinated and scalable as the company grows.

rounds.content:
{"action":"clarify","round":1,"message":"Got it — onboarding is messy across HR, IT, Legal, and managers. There are a few different products that could solve this. Which is closest to what you want?

A) Onboarding workflow tracker — checklists per new hire across HR/IT/Legal/manager, with status visibility and handoffs (no AI, humans drive the steps)
B) Onboarding coordinator with smart task routing — AI reads the role/country/department and auto-generates the right task list per new hire, then humans execute
C) New hire portal — the new employee logs in and sees their personalized checklist, docs to sign, training to complete, and equipment status
D) Policy & onboarding Q&A assistant — AI chatbot that answers new hires' questions from internal HR/IT/Legal docs with citations"}

Stakeholders get email notifications when tasks are assigned, overdue, or completed.

parsed.message: We'll build an onboarding workflow tracker that coordinates HR, IT, Legal, and department managers around per-new-hire checklists. HR creates new hire records (with role, country, department, start date), and the system auto-generates a checklist from configurable templates that can vary by role, country, and department. Each owner sees and updates their assigned tasks (including first-class equipment-access and compliance-training items), with handoffs between departments tracked explicitly. Stakeholders get email notifications on assignment, overdue, and completion. HR admins get a dashboard showing bottlenecks and per-country stats, Legal sees an audit log of every action, and HR can export status reports as CSV.

tasks.summary: Set up storage for new hires, onboarding tasks, checklist templates, departments, countries, and audit history.
tasks.task: Tables: countries, departments, users, checklist_templates, checklist_template_items, new_hires, onboarding_tasks, audit_log. Indexes: onboarding_tasks(new_hire_id), onboarding_tasks(assignee_user_id, status), onboarding_tasks(due_date), new_hires(country_id, department_id, start_date), audit_log(new_hire_id, created_at DESC), checklist_template_items(template_id). Column-level contract: data_model.

tasks.summary: Build the API for managing new hires, generating checklists from templates, updating tasks, sending email notifications, and exporting reports.
tasks.task: Data: pg Pool from env. Endpoints + bodies: api_contract. Behaviors + rules + side-effects: business_logic_contract. Auth: x-amzn-oidc-data JWT sub/email; map to users row on first login; role drives access (hr/it/legal/manager/admin/new_hire). Checklist generation: on new_hire create, select matching template by role+country+department (most specific first), instantiate onboarding_tasks with assignee resolution by owner_role. Email notifications via SMTP env on task assigned/overdue/completed (overdue via daily sweep endpoint). CSV export streams text/csv. Audit log appended on every task write. Equipment access and compliance training are first-class task_type enums.

tasks.summary: Build the UI for HR to create new hires, owners to work their task queues, admins to monitor progress, and Legal to review the audit log.
tasks.task: Views + components: ui_contract. Endpoints + body shapes: api_contract (prepend /api/). States: spinner, empty CTA, toast on 4xx/5xx, 404 page, disabled submit during POST. Responsive. Role-aware nav: new hires see their checklist; HR/IT/Legal/managers see MyTasks queue; admins see Dashboard + AuditLog; HR sees NewHires list + create + templates + CSV export button.

triggers.action: create users row from OIDC claims with role='new_hire' default

select most-specific matching active template by role+country+department, instantiate onboarding_tasks from template items with due_date = start_date + offset_days, resolve assignee_user_id by owner_role (round-robin within department for hr/it/legal; hiring_manager for manager tasks)
mark completed_at, send email to HR and next-stage owner, recompute new_hire.status (complete when all tasks complete)
daily job finds tasks where due_date < today and status != complete, emails assignee + HR
append audit_log row with actor, action, before/after details

rules: Only role='hr' or 'admin' can create new hires, templates, and template items.
Only role='admin' can access /admin/* endpoints (dashboard, audit).
Users can PATCH a task only if they are the assignee, or role in (hr, admin), or (role='manager' and they are the hiring_manager_user_id of the new hire).
New hires (role='new_hire') see only their own new_hire record and tasks where owner_role='new_hire'.
Legal role has read access to /admin/audit and /new-hires/:id/audit.
task_type must be one of: general, equipment_access, compliance_training, paperwork, training, access_provisioning, introduction.
Templates resolve by specificity: exact (role+country+department) > (role+country) > (role+department) > (role) > (country+department) > default; only is_active=true considered.
side_effects: Audit log row written on every create/update/delete of new_hires, onboarding_tasks, and templates.
Email notifications sent on task assignment, completion, and overdue (via SMTP env).
